comments.body: I would start with definitions and theorems from the lecture, then try to gain intuition for them by solving easy exercises like computations or applications. (Books like Analysis 1 and Prüfungstrainer Lineare Algebra by Thomas CT Micheals are helpful for finding lots of easy exercises to gain intuition.) Then I would try to understand and remember the proofs from the lecture and then I would solve more advanced exercises.
comments.author: yungSturrr
